symptom: A JSON member with any character outside `[A-Za-z0-9_]` — `$type` (43 occurrences in the demo apps), `research%3Aread`, `https%3A//…` — makes `create json structure` produce a project mxbuild refuses to build (**CE9524**); and the structure root carries `MinOccurs 0` where Studio Pro writes `1`
cause: `resolveExposedName` only CAPITALISED the member name, never sanitised it, so an invalid character reached the stored ExposedName. Separately `rootMinOccurs` was pinned to 0 with a documented reason: writing 1 used to make every mapping bound to the structure fail **CE5015** "Attribute 'MinOccurs' does not match schema element" because the mapping serializers hardcoded 0
insight: **The MinOccurs blocker was removed by a different fix**: #277/#279 made every mapping element mirror the bound schema element, so both sides now agree and the root can carry the 1 — check whether a documented "cannot change this" still holds before accepting it, because the constraint may have been fixed elsewhere. Do not revert one without the other; they are cross-validated and CE5015 is what disagreement looks like. The sanitising rule is Studio Pro's, read off CRS_ModelSimulator: every character outside `[A-Za-z0-9_]` becomes `_`, then the initial is capitalised (`confidence(No)` → `Confidence_No_`, `first(Importance)_Payload (kg)` → `First_Importance__Payload__kg_`); a LEADING DIGIT is prefixed rather than replaced, since the name must start with a letter or underscore and `1st` → `_st` would lose a character. Unlike the reserved-name case (#300), CE9524's message is accurate here. **The array-item naming in the same issue was NOT reproduced, deliberately**: Studio Pro produces both real singularisation (`Data`→`Datum`, `Categories`→`Category`) and a flat `JsonObject`/`JsonObject_2` across the nine pinned structures, and it is not a collision fallback — nothing named `Embedding` exists in the structure whose item is `JsonObject`. There is no single rule to copy, so picking one would match some real documents and break others. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/mapping-272-json-structure-metadata.mdl`, tests `mdl/types/json_exposed_name_test.go`. Issue ako/mxcli#272
